latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of date-skill — your respectful, privacy-focused dating memory co-pilot.

- Lets you securely record and organize memories, preferences, and insights about people you’re seeing, all stored locally.
- Builds automatically updated profiles so you can easily recall key details, thoughtful gestures, and important dates.
- Suggests personalized date and gift ideas based on what you’ve recorded — no generic advice, no manipulative tactics.
- Includes a green/yellow/red flag tracker for self-reflection and clearer decision-making.
- Operates with strict privacy: stores only your notes, never accesses social media or external data, and never transmits anything off-device.
